scope: Read-only source/configuration investigation while frozen e3a9afa CI builds. No device or source edits.
capability_facts: AppleCLCD start sets IOUserClientClass, external=false, DisplayPipePlaneBaseAlignment=64. No pixel-format/wide-gamut/scaler capability property is implemented.
AppleCLCD externalMethod handles selectors3,4,5,7,8,12,18,28,72; other selectors return success with zero scalar/struct output. Zero-success does not establish a correct capability contract.
SweetSurface allocates arbitrary caller-selected pixel formats and planes; it is an allocator, not a BGRA-only display capability advertisement.
Presenter copies four-byte elements with memcpy without validating pixelFormat or converting RGB10/alpha planes. Safe intended input is plain BGRA, unit elements and a validated linear byte layout.
No AGXAccelerator or IOAcceleratorES registration found in active XNU source/tools/patches. Existing logs show those class matches return none.
Surface traps4/5 release per-client references and are not display present/fence completion events.

Restored followup eventually records done1 with no layer logs. Earlier successful same baseline creates1125x2436 BGRA fullscreen surfaces; restored uses960x2079 BGRA plus960x2079 and1125x2436 b3a8 surfaces.
b3a8 is uncompressed30RGBLE_8A_BiPlanar; compressed AGX alternative is &b38. No speculative allocation rejection is selected.

available_configuration.source: Original extracted IPSW OS plists, not a readback of current writable iOS userdata.
available_configuration.recipe: tools/sweet-root-tweaks.py adjusts boot/activation/setup/audio/watchdogs; no CA renderer or gamut override.

next_data_plan: Use frozen nord2fbdiag=1 first8 swaps and callback summaries to distinguish mask0/nonzero IDs, no callbacks, ownership failures, missing surfaces and successful copies.

If records are empty, capture bounded input/output bytes for only observed framebuffer capability selectors15,22,29,33,52,68,74,79,84 and correlate with actual iOS16 IOMobileFramebuffer callers. Do not invent selector meanings.

Trace the consumed format/scaler/display characteristics fields in exact shipped IOMobileFramebuffer/QuartzCore before implementing a BGRA-only capability answer. Unknown selectors should not be broadly changed until their callers/error handling are established.

Keep the IOSurface allocator general. Do not reject RGB10A8 allocations globally to force an unproven compositor fallback. A presenter format guard/conversion is separate from display capabilities and requires hardware record evidence.
cpu_frequency_facts: Nord2 ADT tools/mkadt-nord2.py hardcodes CPU clock-frequency2000000000 for cores0..3 and2600000000 for cores4..7. These are advertised metadata, not current hardware frequency measurements.
pe_identify_machine reads ADT frequency properties into gPEClockFrequencyInfo; no PLL programming occurs in that path. SweetCPU contains PSCI/GIC startup, no MediaTek DVFS implementation.

Selected Android MT6893 cpufreq_v1 platform source computes physical frequency from ARMPLL_CON1 PCW/postdiv and MCUCFG divider. get_cur_phy_freq reads only those registers; a future snapshot should also record mux bits to identify active clock source.

Known candidate read-only source addresses: APMIXED0x1000c000+0x20c,0x22c,0x23c,0x24c,0x21c; MCUCFG0x0c530000+0xa2a0..0xa2b0. No snapshot exists in the inspected boot logs; no inference of max/min frequency is justified.
boot_cost_facts: Prior fastlog boot measured100.0895s stage6-to-GUI ownership and58.4852s framebuffer processing; this is not lockscreen readiness.
The new10Hz push and correct W0C/idle protocol need current hardware timing. Remaining per-byte pmsg/barrier/lock work is outside fb_ticks, while glyph, clears, push waits are inside.
Traffic ratio is not a boot speedup estimate. UFS aggregate profile and current display callbacks must be read alongside timing.
analysis_limit: REA skill read; saved doctor indicates native engine/provider unavailable and no connected REA MCP registration. No closed-library disassembly performed, no exact private capability selector asserted.
